label: monk2-s9
summary: The model approximates the MONK-2 target ("two of the six attributes at their first value") as a count with a brake and a veto, and reaches training AUC 0.794 (accuracy 78.6%). The direct terms, together with the a2 third-value term, raise the score for first values of a1, a2, a3, a4 and a6. A gate on a2, a3, a4 and a6 (the brake) switches on for 120 of 345 training rows, mostly those with three or more first values, and pulls the score down hard; switching it off drops the AUC to 0.545. a5 at its first value is a veto instead of a counted first value: the model predicts no for 108 of the 108 input combinations with it, which loses the 20 training positives that have a5 at its first value (outcome rate 100% in that group, mean predicted risk below 1%). Over the 432 combinations, "two first values and a5 not at its first value" matches the model on 361, the plain target rule on 333. Two small parts (an a2 third-value term and an a5 third-value hinge) adjust the score, and a chain on a3 and a5 is inactive (on for 0 training rows). Coverage is full and the rewritten model reproduces the original (maximum error 4.4e-16).
